public_rationale: GPT-5 was obtained and released without itself achieving AGI, according to its developer's launch assessment. Under the direct-sufficiency reading signaled by Marcus's reference to Premise 2, obtaining that system first therefore did not directly deliver AGI. This does not establish who will win a broader national race or whether GPT-5 offers an indirect research advantage.
limitations: This resolves the direct implication from possessing GPT-5, not an eventual geopolitical outcome.
Exclusive first access by a country is not established.
The AGI conclusion depends on the initial-release interpretation and relies here on a reported developer assessment.
A broader reading about all downstream effects would remain open.
